findings.why: The proposed yellow chromate coating contains hexavalent chromium. The ELV ban applies in the EU market, where BR-310 is sold (PRG-Y, MKT-EU). The Annex II exemption for corrosion-preventive coatings has expired. The ban continues under Regulation (EU) 2026/1738.

findings.why: BR-310 belongs only to PRG-Y, whose customer is Nordhavn. A coating change needs written Nordhavn approval before the first shipment. No approval in the documents covers this change.
